name: greenhouse_steady_state
title: Steady-state energy and moisture balance of a Venlo greenhouse
summary: Night design point of a single-glass Venlo tomato greenhouse: the pipe-rail heating power that holds the air at its set-point, and the canopy, cover, floor and pipe temperatures, air humidity and all heat and vapour fluxes, from the correlations of the Greenhouses Modelica library (de Zwart, Bot, Stanghellini, Boulard & Baille).

verification.summary: Flat EES translation of the Greenhouses Modelica library equations; the solution was checked against an independent scipy re-implementation of the same equations (27 quantities): max relative difference 1.1e-11. Plausibility: Q_pip = 198 W/m2 and K_glob = 7.1 W/m2K at -10 degC, typical for single glass. A control-volume check that is not a model equation closes to 2e-10 W/m2.
verification.reference: greenhouse_steady_state_ref.py in this folder (scipy.optimize.root of the same equations); correlations of the Greenhouses library and Altes-Buch et al.
verification.notes: No Dymola/OM result was available for this boundary condition (the Modelica example runs a full year with controls). 2026-11-10: the floor balance was missing -q_rad_flr_cov; the model was corrected, re-solved and compared again.

related_external: Greenhouses Modelica library, example Greenhouse_2 (source of the translation; stays in its own repository)
